_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 7 OF 10: THE SHIPMENT.
The occupiers have a shipment staged to leave. Take their leader, lock the shipment down at the loading terminal,
and hold the way in when the people waiting for it arrive. The verb is LOCK.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Seizure: Outbound Shipment on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The occupiers of the <Place> have a shipment staged to go out. If it leaves, it's gone for good.
prose.card: Seizure contract. A shipment staged at the <Place> on <Planet> must not leave. Lock it down at the loading terminal and hold until it is secured. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Defeat the occupiers' leader at the <Place>
beats.journal: The occupiers' leader at the <Place> is dead. Her shipment is still staged to go.
say: She's down? Then the shipment's next.
Lock it at the loading terminal before anyone else can send it.

beats.objective: Lock the shipment at the loading terminal
beats.journal: The shipment is locked down at the <Place>. Nobody can send it now without a code they don't have.
beats.name: Loading Terminal
say: And now whoever was coming to collect it is going to be annoyed. They're nearly there.

beats.journal: The shipment at the <Place> is locked down, and the people who came to collect it went home empty.
say: We'll have it secured within the hour. Well done.

broadcast: There's a shipment in there that's meant to leave tonight. It doesn't.
Lock it at the loading terminal.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
